sheets.character_en: Alice, a female child: a ten-year-old English girl of 1862, about 135 cm tall, slight and straight-backed, with small hands. Long warm mid-brown hair reaching past her shoulder blades, slightly overgrown, worn loose and free with a centre parting, straight to softly waved, without ringlets and without any hairband; a few stray strands fall across her eyes. Large, wide-set, bright and alert grey-blue eyes; straight brows a shade darker than her hair; a small straight nose; a full lower lip; a soft oval child's face with no freckles; fair skin with lightly sun-flushed cheeks. Curious, frank expression with the chin slightly lifted. Natural, age-appropriate standing pose with relaxed arms; the pinafore's front patch pocket is clearly visible in the front view and the sash bow is visible in the back view.
sheets.prompt_final: Four-panel character reference sheet following the reference layout: three full-body views (front / side / back) left to right, and one large head-and-shoulders close-up filling the right column; the exact same character, outfit and proportions in every panel; plain background. The sheet looks like four production photographs mounted side by side on one board: the image is divided by three thin vertical gaps into three narrow full-height panels on the left and one wide panel on the right. Panel 1: full-body front view, standing naturally, facing the camera. Panel 2: full-body side profile view facing right. Panel 3: full-body back view. Panel 4 (right column): large head-and-shoulders close-up, facing the camera or a slight three-quarter turn, the face sharp and clear. Each full-body view shows the whole figure from the top of the head to the soles of the shoes with clear space above and below, a small patch of floor and a soft contact shadow under the feet; any part cut off by a panel edge makes the sheet invalid. Plain seamless warm light-grey studio backdrop in every panel, soft even light, no scenery. Identity lock: one and the same person in all four panels, with the same face, hair, build and costume; exactly one figure per panel; no duplicated or extra figures. Character: Alice, a female child: a ten-year-old English girl of 1862, about 135 cm tall, slight and straight-backed, with small hands. Long warm mid-brown hair reaching past her shoulder blades, slightly overgrown, worn loose and free with a centre parting, straight to softly waved, without ringlets and without any hairband; a few stray strands fall across her eyes. Large, wide-set, bright and alert grey-blue eyes; straight brows a shade darker than her hair; a small straight nose; a full lower lip; a soft oval child's face with no freckles; fair skin with lightly sun-flushed cheeks. Curious, frank expression with the chin slightly lifted. Natural, age-appropriate standing pose with relaxed arms; the pinafore's front patch pocket is clearly visible in the front view and the sash bow is visible in the back view. Costume: a pale cornflower-blue cotton summer frock of 1862 with a wide rounded neckline, short puffed sleeves and a fitted bodice, the full bell skirt ending just below the knee over starched white cotton petticoats without a hoop; over it a crisp white cotton pinafore with a bib front, frilled shoulder straps, a sash tied in a bow at the back and one deep patch pocket at the front; white cotton stockings; black leather flat ankle-strap shoes; bare-headed; soft matte cotton weave, clean and lightly creased. Style: Photorealistic live-action fantasy film rooted in England in 1862, shot on 35mm film with anamorphic lenses, 16:9 widescreen. Real sets, real locations and real costumed actors in 1862 dress. Wonderland spaces are real built sets and set extensions in an Alphonse Mucha-inspired Art Nouveau design: flowing organic lines, floral and vine ornament, circular halo roundels, mosaic and stained glass, aged pastel-and-gold surfaces with patina and moss; the waking 1862 meadow stays plain period realism. Talking animals and fantastical creatures are photoreal CGI animals with naturalistic anatomy, real fur, feathers, skin and scales, lit by the same light and grounded with real contact shadows. Natural and practical light: sunlight, candlelight and oil lamps, soft haze with volumetric light shafts and soft colour through stained glass. Restrained palette of verdigris teal, slate grey, dusty rose, soft sage and lilac pastels and tarnished-gold accents, warmed by amber sun and candle glow. Fine film grain, gentle halation, soft depth of field, grounded and quietly melancholy. Layout recap (highest priority): four separate photographic panels side by side on one sheet: front, side profile, back, head-and-shoulders close-up; plain studio backdrop; never one single full-bleed picture.
